_meta.description: Real metrics extracted from the original MSc experiments on the private Mersin University wisdom-tooth-resorption dataset.

baseline.notes: Classifier collapsed to predicting only the majority class (temasli). Confusion matrix: [[130,0,0],[84,0,0],[92,0,0]].

improved.notes: Best of 10 attention/transformer variants evaluated. ViT-Base-16 narrowly edged out Swin-Tiny (F1 0.9003), DenseNet-Attention (0.8946) and ResNet50-SE (0.8800).

improvement_explanation: Replacing the from-scratch CNN baseline with an ImageNet-pretrained Vision Transformer lifted macro-F1 from 0.20 to 0.90 on the same held-out test split. Transfer learning + global self-attention let the model exploit the ~55-image clinical dataset that was far too small to train a convnet from scratch.

external_benchmarks.note: The MSc work additionally compared a YOLOv11 detection baseline that, like the original CNN, collapsed on this dataset (F1_macro = 0.2071, accuracy = 0.4281).
